trojan_horses.description: Disguised software that opens unauthorized remote access vectors.

logic_bombs_time_bombs.description: Malicious code designed to detonate or execute after specific conditions or time delays are met.

spyware.description: Software designed to silently monitor, intercept, and exfiltrate sensitive user data.

phishing_links.description: Deceptive infrastructure designed to harvest user credentials and sensitive session tokens.

worms.description: Standalone malware that actively replicates itself to spread across local networks to other devices.

ransomware.description: Malicious software that encrypts user storage volumes and demands a payout for decryption.

adware.description: Software that aggressively forces unwanted advertisements or hijacked search queries onto the user.

rootkits.description: Deep system-level access tools designed to hide the existence of malware from standard scanners.
